summary: Proacct+ is a Heidelberg VIC firm combining accounting and tax, bookkeeping, virtual CFO, financial planning and mortgages. It runs a long-standing niche managing finances for ski clubs and body corporates, with monthly bank reconciliations and quarterly BAS on its service list. Partner Anthony Contessa is a CPA whose LinkedIn lists MYOB.

The firm says that although committee members change, it provides consistency for clubs.
claims.quote: While committee members come and go, we are always there to provide consistency, transparency, and reliability.

claims.quote: A virtual CFO is similar to an in-house chief financial officer in that you get the benefits of having an experienced financial professional

claims.text: The firm has a separate bookkeeping service that handles daily processing and payroll.
Proacct+ combines financial planning, mortgage lending and accounting under one roof.
claims.quote: offers financial planning, mortgage lending and accounting services all under the same roof

hooks.text: Monthly bank reconciliations are an explicit deliverable for recurring club and body corporate clients, a repeatable reconciliation workload.
Committees turn over while Proacct+ stays constant, so a traceable audit trail suits their consistency pitch.
Virtual CFO and bookkeeping lines both depend on faster reconciling.

risks.text: Multi-service firm (planning and mortgages too); accounting is one of three pillars.
Anthony's LinkedIn mentions MYOB only; no confirmed use of an AI reconciliation tool either way.

gaps: No blog, news, podcast or recent LinkedIn posts from the firm or Anthony found.
No Xero/MYOB partner directory listing found.

first.subject: Reconciliation at Proacct+
first.body:
Hi Anthony,

Noticed Proacct+ has built a niche looking after clubs and body corporates, with monthly bank reconciliations and quarterly BAS on the service list. That is a lot of recurring reconciling, and your LinkedIn lists MYOB. I built Vert to turn hours of manual reconciliation into minutes, with a traceable audit trail rather than AI that auto-codes and guesses. How much of your team's month goes on reconciling across your club clients? Open to a 10 min walkthrough?
Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech
